summary: Security E2E tests: 564/594 failures (94.9%) due to missing implementation

failures.test_name: should successfully login with valid credentials
failures.suggested_fix: Add data-testid='dashboard-view' to dashboard component in src/pages/Dashboard.tsx

failures.test_name: should reject login with incorrect password
failures.expected: Error message displayed for incorrect password
failures.suggested_fix: Add data-testid='login-error' to error message component in login form

failures.test_name: should lock account after 5 failed login attempts
failures.actual: Login continues to accept attempts after 5 failures
failures.suggested_fix: Implement account lockout mechanism in backend authentication service

failures.test_name: should display rate limiting error after too many requests
failures.suggested_fix: Implement rate limiting middleware and add data-testid='rate-limit-error' to error component

failures.actual: Password reset form elements not found (timeout 10000ms)
failures.suggested_fix: Implement password reset UI with data-testid='reset-email-input' in password reset page

failures.test_name: should include CSRF token in state-changing requests
failures.suggested_fix: Implement CSRF token generation and validation middleware in backend

failures.test_name: should set security headers on responses
failures.expected: X-Frame-Options, CSP, HSTS, etc. headers present
failures.actual: All security headers NOT SET (logged in test output)
failures.suggested_fix: Add security headers middleware in backend (helmet.js or equivalent)
Implement session ID regeneration on authentication events in session middleware

failures.test_name: should sanitize script tags in text inputs
failures.expected: XSS test page loads with input validation
failures.actual: Test page not found or input elements missing (timeout 10000ms)
failures.suggested_fix: Implement XSS prevention in input handling and output rendering

notes: Tests are well-designed but implementation is incomplete. Most failures due to missing UI elements (data-testid attributes) and unimplemented security features (CSRF, rate limiting, account lockout, security headers). Tests themselves represent Level 4 security validation but cannot proceed due to missing implementation foundation.
